children: EigenCloud is scheduled to unlock 36.82 million EIGEN for investors and the team in December 2026. The monthly release amounts to 3.61% of the token's circulating supply.
Once the tokens are unlocked, recipients can sell them. If investors or team members put some of their new tokens up for sale, the extra supply may weigh on EIGEN's price until buyers absorb it.
